milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted blue_carpet ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with only 2 blue_wool and no blue_carpet, so having ≥1 blue_carpet in inventory confirms successful crafting. The recipe (2 blue wool side by side → 3 blue carpet) is a 1x2 pattern craftable in either the 2x2 inventory grid or the 3x3 crafting table. Checking min_count=1 rather than 3 is intentionally relaxed in case the player places some carpet blocks.
